branch_activations.carrier: placement is added to, not substituted for, descent
branch_activations.activation: Proper placement meets the measured and deliberated context, making descent the placement phase.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus movement completes the fit by assigning each matter its station.
branch_activations.boundary: The physical downward movement remains present throughout.

findings.title: Knowledge made public
findings.claim: The passage from knowing to announcing becomes a possible macro movement: what is encountered as knowledge can cross into public communication.
findings.mechanism: The question of knowing meets the focus permission word's knowledge-and-reporting facets and the learned-teacher facet of Lord, while the month cue supplies public exposure as the surrounding direction.
findings.reader_payoff: The verse's authorized descent can be perceived as disclosure moving from inaccessible knowledge toward communicable presence.
findings.containment: This retains the ordinary authorization and descent; it does not turn the focus into a standalone proclamation formula.

epistemic.reason: The carrier and trigger are supplied, while the source remains a candidate or attributed contextual inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Birinci çekirdek yön, bir şey hakkında bilgi sahibi olmaktır.
branch_activations.activation: The knowledge facet meets the knowledge question, making knowing an explicit entry condition for the later permission relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus permission can be heard at the threshold where knowledge is held.
branch_activations.boundary: Only knowledge pressure is retained in this activation; public announcement belongs to the paired facet.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İkinci çekirdek yön, bir bilgiyi başka bir kişiye bildirmektir.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: the focus permission carrier and supplied public-visibility evidence
branch_activations.activation: The reporting facet meets the surrounding public-visibility cue, so the known content can cross into communicable form.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Authorization becomes a passage from private cognition to disclosed message.
branch_activations.boundary: The finding does not claim a named public call in the surface grammar.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi Tanrı bilgisiyle ve dinî konulardaki sağlam bilgisiyle tanımlanır.
branch_activations.carrier: learned authority without a named human teacher
branch_activations.independent_trigger: the supplied knowing and teaching evidence
branch_activations.activation: The learned-teacher facet meets the question's knowledge pressure, giving the relational Lord a teaching-bearing contour.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The source of authorization can be perceived as knowledge that is capable of transmission.
branch_activations.boundary: No specific human sage is asserted; the facet is contextual and attributed.

findings.title: Authority frame
findings.claim: Lordship, public sovereignty, and the capacity to command form an authority frame around the descending action.
findings.mechanism: The focus word for their Lord, the angelic subject, and the final affair each carry authority facets; the preceding sending and measure cues provide the independent pericope setting.
findings.reader_payoff: The verse's permission is seen as issuing from an operative relation of authority rather than as an unexplained clearance.
findings.containment: The ordinary Lord, angels, and affairs remain unchanged; the context-only capacity branch is excluded and no political scene is asserted.

epistemic.reason: The carrier and trigger are supplied, while the source remains a candidate or attributed contextual inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam, yönetme yetkisi ve bu yetkiye bağlı makamdır.
branch_activations.activation: The command-office facet meets the Lordship and measure context, making the affair executable within an authority frame.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The final affair is connected to direction, not merely occurrence.
branch_activations.boundary: The finding does not identify a human office or institution.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi ve yönetip düzenleme aynı çekirdekte birleşir.
branch_activations.carrier: relational Lordship as the source of authorization
branch_activations.independent_trigger: permission, command, and the preceding descent
branch_activations.activation: The focus Lordship facet meets the permission and command setting, supplying the source-side authority.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The phrase Rab-Their permission is heard as relational ownership, command, and ordering.
branch_activations.boundary: The absolute theological scope is kept within the supplied wording.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Hükümdar, halk üzerinde emir ve yasak koyarak kamusal yönetim yetkisi kullanır.
branch_activations.carrier: sovereignty as contextual pressure on the agent relation
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Lordship and command in the focus clause
branch_activations.activation: The sovereignty facet meets the named Lordship and executable affair, giving the angelic subject an authority-colored position.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The descending agents appear within an effective command structure.
branch_activations.boundary: This is an attributed authority frame, not a claim that the angels are rulers of the world.

findings.title: Bounded transformation
findings.claim: The focus can receive a contained transformation image in which a thickening substance and fragrant plant meet the measured vessel cue of the preceding context.
findings.mechanism: The context's qadr term supplies the independent vessel image; focus facets for dark thickener and herb then give the contents a process of thickening and seasoning.
findings.reader_payoff: Abstract measure acquires a tactile scene of contents being prepared within limits.
findings.containment: The vessel, stew, and cooking branches are not retained as exact context carriers; the finding keeps only the focus-carried thickening and herb facets.

epistemic.reason: The carrier and trigger are supplied, while the source remains a candidate or attributed contextual inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Deri, kap, yiyecek ve ilaç bu maddeyle işlenir, sağlamlaştırılır veya hazırlanır.
branch_activations.carrier: processing material associated with a vessel
branch_activations.independent_trigger: the qadr and vessel nomination in 97:1-3
branch_activations.activation: The processing facet of the dark residue meets the independently supplied bounded-vessel cue, giving the Lord word a material transformation pressure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The affair setting can be perceived as contents being prepared and strengthened within a limit.
branch_activations.boundary: No literal kitchen or cook is asserted; the image remains a contextual resonance.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Sözcük bilinen kokulu bitkiyi adlandırır.
branch_activations.carrier: fragrant plant as a contents-level contribution
branch_activations.independent_trigger: the supplied pot and thickening evidence
branch_activations.activation: The herb facet meets the same vessel cue, supplying fragrance and seasoning to the bounded transformation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The Spirit word contributes a distinct plant element to the preparation scene.
branch_activations.boundary: The ordinary definite Spirit remains available; plant meaning is a retained contextual facet.

findings.title: Sending and repeated descent
findings.claim: The prior sending-down and the focus's agent-subject descent can be heard as coordinated phases of one vertical delivery, while a countable descent facet remains visible within it.
findings.mechanism: The same descent field appears first with a causative sender and then with descending agents; the focus's staged, revelatory, and single-event facets let delivery, repetition, and event-count coexist.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the focus action answer the earlier sending rather than standing as an isolated arrival.
findings.containment: The recurring and countable facets coexist; one event does not erase the ongoing form, and the physical descent remains primary.

epistemic.reason: The carrier and trigger are supplied, while the source remains a candidate or attributed contextual inference.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: aşağı inme veya bir yere konaklama
branch_activations.facet_statement: İniş, bir anda değil ağır ağır ve aşamalı biçimde gerçekleşebilir.
branch_activations.activation: The staged-descent facet meets the prior causative sending and makes the focus action a continuing arrival.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The agents descend through an unfolding process.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus verb is not reduced to a single point event.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: Tanrısal iyilik, ceza veya bildiriyi insanlara ulaştırma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Tanrısal bildiri bölüm bölüm ve tekrar tekrar ulaştırılabilir.
branch_activations.carrier: repeated divine delivery as a contextual facet
branch_activations.independent_trigger: the prior sending-down and the focus descent
branch_activations.activation: The repeated-revelatory facet meets the earlier sending, so the focus descent can operationalize delivery in recurring form.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The night contains a delivery process with more than one temporal role.
branch_activations.boundary: No frequency beyond the supplied repeated facet is asserted.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İniş eylemi tek bir olay veya tek bir gerçekleşme olarak sayılır.
branch_activations.carrier: a countable descent within a continuing operation
branch_activations.independent_trigger: the focus form and prior sending
branch_activations.activation: The countable-event facet meets the paired sending/descent forms, preserving an event-sized view inside the wider process.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The descent may be counted as a realization without losing its repeated setting.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not adjudicate between event and process.

findings.title: Counted multitude
findings.claim: The counted temporal field of the preceding comparison meets the focus's multitude and totality facets, making the descending subject and its affairs perceptible at collective scale.
findings.mechanism: The thousand-month comparison supplies an independent count and duration; focus branches for a large gathering, collective groups, and exhaustive totality extend that arithmetic into a whole set.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why every affair is compatible with a collective descent without turning the quantifier into a mere rhetorical intensifier.
findings.containment: The ordinary thousand-month comparison and focus totality remain intact; the context-only numerical and calendar branches are not separately activated.

epistemic.reason: The carrier and trigger are supplied, while the source remains a candidate or attributed contextual inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel anlam, insanların büyük sayıda bir araya gelerek topluluk oluşturmasıdır.
branch_activations.activation: The large-community facet meets the counted multitude of 97:3, giving the Lord word a collective-scale pressure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The named Lord relation can receive a gathered host image.
branch_activations.boundary: No demographic identity is claimed for the focus agents.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin parçalarının veya bir kümedeki bireylerin hiçbirini dışarıda bırakmadan kapsanması çekirdektir.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: the exact count and duration cue
branch_activations.activation: The exhaustive facet meets the large temporal count, extending the comparison toward full inclusion.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The final scope phrase can contain the whole field rather than a sample.
branch_activations.boundary: Completeness is contextual, not a new translation of كلِّ.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir arada bulunan birden çok topluluğu veya kümeyi adlandırmak çekirdektir.
branch_activations.activation: The collective-group facet meets the gathered count, giving the whole a visibly grouped structure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The affairs are perceived as organized clusters within the totality.
branch_activations.boundary: The candidate does not specify a particular group type.

findings.title: Articulated living body
findings.claim: The Spirit and the focus relations can be heard as a living body whose core, palm, chest, ear, and sustaining mainstay make animation structured rather than diffuse.
findings.mechanism: The vital-spirit facet meets body-part facets carried by the focus words, while the following peace cue supplies the independent life-and-safety setting.
findings.reader_payoff: The abstract descent acquires an image of life organized through connected parts and a sustaining center.
findings.containment: The ordinary Spirit and angelic descent remain recoverable; the nominated quiver and joint branches are not retained, and no literal body is asserted.

epistemic.reason: The carrier and trigger are supplied, while the source remains a candidate or attributed contextual inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel gönderge, canlıların işitmeye yarayan kulak organıdır.
branch_activations.activation: The anatomical-ear facet meets the vital-body setting supplied by the focus and its peace continuation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: A sensory organ gives the living image a point of reception.
branch_activations.boundary: The permission word is not translated as an ear; the organ is a contextual facet.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İç varlık bedene canlılık verir ve onun ayrılması beden yaşamının sona ermesini bildirir.
branch_activations.activation: The life-giving facet meets the body-part network, making Spirit the animating presence of the image.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Movement becomes animation of an organized living form.
branch_activations.boundary: The supplied uncertainty about the identity of the inner life remains visible.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Avuç içi elin nesne kavrarken içe bakan yüzüdür.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: the vital Spirit and articulated-body support
branch_activations.activation: The palm facet meets the animating Spirit facet, giving the body a grasping surface.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Life becomes capable of contact and action.
branch_activations.boundary: The palm is an image contribution, not a claim about the physical form of the Spirit.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bedenin ön üst bölümündeki göğüs bölgesinin adı olması tek ve doğrudan çekirdektir.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: the focus body network and peace setting
branch_activations.activation: The chest facet meets the life-giving and mainstay facets, giving the body an upper core.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The living image gains a center around which the other parts are organized.
branch_activations.boundary: No anatomical reading replaces the universal scope of كلِّ.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir unsur, daha büyük bir işin veya düzenin dayandığı ve onun düzgün işlemesini sağlayan temeldir.
branch_activations.activation: The mainstay facet meets the body-part network, supplying the condition that keeps the articulated whole functioning.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The body is held together by a sustaining center.
branch_activations.boundary: This is not a claim that the angels are a body in the ordinary sense.

findings.title: Weather and growth cycle
findings.claim: Wind, layered cloud, descending rain, and renewed foliage form a compact weather-to-growth sequence around the focus descent.
findings.mechanism: The wind and cloud facets meet the focus descent, whose rain example then meets the foliage facet; the dawn context supplies emergence as the boundary of the process.
findings.reader_payoff: Descent becomes materially generative: air gathers, water falls, and living growth persists.
findings.containment: The nominated gushing-water and sprouting branches are not independently carried; the retained image is limited to the exact focus facets.

epistemic.reason: The carrier and trigger are supplied, while the source remains a candidate or attributed contextual inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bulut parçaları üst üste binmiş veya aşağıda asılı duran belirgin bir küme oluşturur.
branch_activations.carrier: layered cloud as a gathered carrier
branch_activations.independent_trigger: air, descent, and the dawn boundary
branch_activations.activation: The layered-cloud facet meets the air and descent cues, giving the Lord word a gathered weather form.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus relation can hold a suspended cloud mass around the descending process.
branch_activations.boundary: Cloud layering is contextual and does not displace the Lord meaning.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Hareket eden hava hafif bir esinti ya da sert bir yel olarak gerçekleşebilir.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: the focus cloud and descent cues
branch_activations.activation: The moving-air facet meets the cloud and descent facets, supplying the first motion of the weather sequence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The Spirit word contributes wind-like motion to the cycle.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a contextual resonance, not a claim that רוח has only a meteorological sense.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Ağaç, yaz sonrasındaki dönemde tomurcuklanıp yeniden yaprak verir.
branch_activations.activation: The renewed-foliage facet meets the rain example and dawn boundary, supplying the cycle's living continuation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Descent can be perceived as feeding renewal rather than ending at arrival.
branch_activations.boundary: No specific plant or crop is identified.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: aşağı inme veya bir yere konaklama
branch_activations.facet_statement: Yağmurun gökten düşmesi, aşağı yönlü hareketin doğal bir örneğidir.
branch_activations.carrier: rain as a bounded analogue of descent
branch_activations.independent_trigger: the focus weather facets and dawn
branch_activations.activation: The rain example meets the air, cloud, and foliage facets, giving the focus descent a natural downward analogue.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The descent participates in a sequence that can produce renewed growth.
branch_activations.boundary: The ordinary angelic descent remains primary.

findings.title: Prepared provision
findings.claim: Ownership and prepared provision let the descent carry a bounded image of goods held under authority for later delivery.
findings.mechanism: The provision facet of descent meets the transfer-of-ownership facet and the night/peace context, separating preparation from the later handover while keeping them in one relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive delivery as a prepared provision with an interval between holding and arrival.
findings.containment: The advance-payment and night-business branches are excluded; the retained core does not assert a full commercial contract.

epistemic.reason: The carrier and trigger are supplied, while the source remains a candidate or attributed contextual inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Sahiplik bir başkasına geçirilebilir veya belirli bir konuda karar yetkisi o kişiye bırakılabilir.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: prepared provision and the peace-bounded night
branch_activations.activation: The transfer facet of ownership meets the prepared-provision and peace cues, supplying the holding-to-receipt relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Authority can include passing a prepared thing into another's use.
branch_activations.boundary: No buyer, price, or legal sale is asserted.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: konuk için hazırlanan yiyecek ve ağırlama payı
branch_activations.facet_statement: Konuğun yararlanması için yiyecek, yol azığı ve ağırlama payı hazırlanır.
branch_activations.activation: The prepared-provision facet meets the prior sending and following peace boundary, making descent the delivery phase.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: What descends can be perceived as a prepared share moving toward reception.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus still says descent of angels and Spirit; provision is a bounded facet.

findings.title: Bounded occurrence
findings.claim: A marked time and a countable descent facet let the focus action be perceived as one appointed occurrence within a larger temporal frame.
findings.mechanism: The fixed-time/sign facet of affair meets the previously marked Night of Qadr, while the one-descent facet makes the movement countable without removing its wider context.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader gains a visible boundary around the event: it happens within an appointed span and can be counted there.
findings.containment: The ordinary indefinite affair and ongoing descent remain available; the context-only qadr and deictic-night branches are not separately activated.

epistemic.reason: The carrier and trigger are supplied, while the source remains a candidate or attributed contextual inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Belirlenmiş zaman veya randevu da bu dalda verilen ayrı bir kapsamdır.
branch_activations.activation: The appointed-time facet meets the previously named Night of Qadr, locating the affair inside a marked interval.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The final affair phrase can be heard against a fixed temporal sign.
branch_activations.boundary: The finding does not calculate a new calendar date.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İniş eylemi tek bir olay veya tek bir gerçekleşme olarak sayılır.
branch_activations.carrier: one countable occurrence within the span
branch_activations.activation: The countable-descent facet meets the appointed interval, allowing one realization to be seen within the span.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Descent has an event boundary as well as a process dimension.
branch_activations.boundary: The event facet does not displace the staged-descent reading.

findings.title: Fatigue and release
findings.claim: The focus can also hold a bodily cycle in which exertion dulls, rest restores, safety releases, and the descent becomes a temporary episode.
findings.mechanism: The fatigue, rest, death, and illness facets meet the night boundary and the following peace wording, producing a cycle of strain and relief around the focus action.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader perceives movement not only as arrival but as a state that can pass through depletion and release.
findings.containment: The nominated bodily-safety branch is not independently landed; the primary angelic descent and the alternative source qualifications remain visible.

epistemic.reason: The carrier and trigger are supplied, while the source remains a candidate or attributed contextual inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Yürüyen insanın ya da hayvanın yorulması ve kılıç, dil, bakış, işitme veya rüzgarın etkisizleşmesi bu çekirdeğin gerçekleşmeleridir.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: the night operation and supplied body cycle
branch_activations.activation: The fatigue facet meets the exertion and night setting, giving the universal scope word a bodily loss-of-sharpness pressure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The field can contain a state of diminished capacity.
branch_activations.boundary: Fatigue is a contextual facet, not a translation of كلِّ.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Dinlenme yorgunluğu hafifletir, soluğu düzenler ve kişinin gücünü yeniden toplamasını sağlar.
branch_activations.activation: The rest facet meets the peace continuation, giving the focus Spirit word a restoration phase.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Descent can be followed by recovered breath and relief within the bounded night.
branch_activations.boundary: Rest does not replace the referent of the Spirit.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi öznesiyle kurulan yapı yaşamın sona ermesi sonucunu bildirir.
branch_activations.carrier: release facet carried by the Spirit word
branch_activations.activation: The death-as-release facet meets the supplied release trajectory, extending relief toward a final boundary.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The cycle can culminate in release as a distinct contextual possibility.
branch_activations.boundary: This is not a claim that the focus event is death.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Aynı biçim soğuk algınlığına benzer geçici bir rahatsızlığın adı olabilir.
branch_activations.carrier: temporary episode as a bounded analogy
branch_activations.independent_trigger: the night boundary and supplied fatigue cycle
branch_activations.activation: The temporary-illness facet meets the episode-like descent and the bounded night, making the action an acute passing state in this resonance.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus movement can be felt as a temporary bodily episode without changing its ordinary scene.
branch_activations.boundary: No medical diagnosis is asserted.

findings.title: Owned means
findings.claim: Ownership joined to increase makes the affairs perceptible as means that can be held and directed toward an outcome.
findings.mechanism: The ownership facet attached to the angelic subject meets the growth facet of affair and the preceding خير/measure field, turning capacity into usable disposition.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees resources as something that can move from possession into action.
findings.containment: The context-only capacity and generosity branches are excluded; no economic reading is imposed on the primary command.

epistemic.reason: The carrier and trigger are supplied, while the source remains a candidate or attributed contextual inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişi, mal veya hak üzerinde sahiplikten doğan elinde bulundurma ve tasarruf yetkisine sahiptir.
branch_activations.activation: The ownership facet meets the growth-and-means cue, giving the subject a held resource relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The descending agents can be viewed in terms of controlled possession and disposition.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not identify a commodity or owner beyond the supplied relation.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam, sayıca veya varlıkça artma ve çoğalmadır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: the preceding خير and capacity cues
branch_activations.activation: The growth facet meets the favorable comparison, making an affair capable of increase and outward use.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The final affairs can be perceived as resources with direction rather than static items.
branch_activations.boundary: No accumulation claim is made for every affair.

findings.title: Handled transport
findings.claim: The focus can support an apparatus image in which an ear-shaped handle and moving air organize controlled transport through a bounded setting.
findings.mechanism: The handle facet attached to permission and the moving-air facet attached to Spirit meet the supplied vessel and peace context, making attached parts and motion explain one another.
findings.reader_payoff: A reader can perceive transport as organized through a point of grip and a moving force.
findings.containment: The pail and bounded-vessel branches are nomination-only context branches; the retained finding is the handle-and-air core.

epistemic.reason: The carrier and trigger are supplied, while the source remains a candidate or attributed contextual inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Biçim benzerliğiyle bir kupa, kap veya tencerenin kulak biçimli tutamağını da gösterebilir.
branch_activations.activation: The ear-handle facet meets the supplied apparatus cue, giving permission's carrier a concrete point of attachment.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Controlled movement can be organized through an attached handle.
branch_activations.boundary: The permission meaning remains primary; the handle is a contextual shape analogy.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Hareket eden hava hafif bir esinti ya da sert bir yel olarak gerçekleşebilir.
branch_activations.activation: The moving-air facet meets the handle apparatus, supplying environmental or mechanical motion around the transported load.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus Spirit word adds force in motion to the organized apparatus.
branch_activations.boundary: No literal machine is asserted.

findings.title: Permissioned dispatch
findings.claim: Lordship, permission, command, totality, sovereignty, and delivery form one bounded authority-to-dispatch relation.
findings.mechanism: The prior sending supplies the independent macro trigger; focus facets connect source authority to permission, command, comprehensive scope, sovereign agency, and downward delivery.
findings.reader_payoff: The descent becomes an ordered charge moving from authority through permission into complete execution.
findings.containment: The ordinary angels, Spirit, permission, and affairs remain primary; no context-only branch is omitted because every supplied candidate branch is landed.

epistemic.reason: The carrier and trigger are supplied, while the source remains a candidate or attributed contextual inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel ilişki, bir kişiye belirli bir işi yapma veya bir yere girme onayı ve yetkisi vermektir.
branch_activations.activation: Permission meets the earlier sending, opening the route by which the charge can pass into action.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus action is authorized dispatch.
branch_activations.boundary: Authorization is not treated as a substitute for descent.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam, yasaklamanın karşıtı olan yapma isteği ve yükümlü kılmadır.
branch_activations.activation: The binding-command facet supplies the executable charge that travels through the permissioned route.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The final affair is a commanded unit of dispatch.
branch_activations.boundary: The command remains an affair-level relation, not a prose thesis about the surah.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi ve yönetip düzenleme aynı çekirdekte birleşir.
branch_activations.activation: Lordship supplies the originating authority for the command and permission.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The source side of dispatch is relationally governed.
branch_activations.boundary: The finding does not expand the supplied Lordship into an independent doctrine.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin parçalarının veya bir kümedeki bireylerin hiçbirini dışarıda bırakmadan kapsanması çekirdektir.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: prior sending and final scope phrase
branch_activations.activation: Total inclusion meets the prior sending, making the dispatch comprehensive rather than fragmentary.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The phrase every affair is read as the scope of the charge.
branch_activations.boundary: Comprehensiveness is retained without claiming an inventory.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Hükümdar, halk üzerinde emir ve yasak koyarak kamusal yönetim yetkisi kullanır.
branch_activations.activation: Sovereignty meets Lordship and command, positioning the angelic subject inside the authority frame.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The agents deliver within effective jurisdiction.
branch_activations.boundary: The angels are not reclassified as sovereigns.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: Tanrısal iyilik, ceza veya bildiriyi insanlara ulaştırma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Tanrısal bildiri bölüm bölüm ve tekrar tekrar ulaştırılabilir.
